integrity: Exact identities and asymptotic optimization are proved analytically. Finite reproducibility checks are diagnostic, not an infinite or independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-parameter Minkowski interpolation C_d+t O_d is optimized.
No finite-dimensional uniqueness or quantified convergence rate is asserted.
The explicit high-dimensional optimum has no independent audit or peer review.
Historical priority within Laguerre-quotient asymptotic work is not exhaustively resolved.
title: Exponential Mahler growth along the cube–cross-polytope Minkowski interpolation
